correctness.rationale: The repaired proof identifies the six vertices of the strict weighted cube section and the two active signed coordinate normers at each. Fixing a normer and maximizing over its face, then over normers at the vertex, establishes the two stated finite maxima for operator norm and numerical radius. For a missing coordinate, the weighted plane relation and the expansion in the other two vertices independently give A_i and B_i. In cyclic orientation for i=1, the expansion coefficients are (1+d)/(e−1) and (1+de)/(e−1), with d=(c−b)/a and e=(a−c)/b, confirming the rational B_i. The proposed rank-one map has value R_i=min(A_i,B_i) at the missing coordinate and all norming entries bounded by one. Applying the coordinate upper bound to this same map forces its radius to be exactly one, and its norm is R_i from the vertex values of its scalar factor. Choosing a maximizing i gives a rank-one numerical-index minimizer; finite-dimensional adjunction preserves rank, norm and numerical radius. Three irredundant pairs of opposite facet constraints describe every centrally symmetric hexagonal norm, and their unique relation, made positive by sign changes, must be strict by irredundancy. This proves the equivalence of the two scopes.
correctness.replay: Use the three cyclic vertices and their two norming coordinates. For each missing coordinate i solve the scalar functional on v_j,v_k as specified, and compute the maximum of the six norming entries and the maximum of the nine coordinate evaluations. The upper-bound identities certify v(T)=1 and ||T||=R_i for every strict triangle.
residual_risks: Real scalars and precisely hexagonal unit balls (or the known collinear parallelogram boundary). No uniqueness of rank-one minimizers or assertion for general higher-facet polygons.

value.rationale: The corrected result answers a natural structural question about restricting the operator class on all hexagonal planes, extending a rank-one phenomenon known on a symmetric subfamily. Rank-one restriction can change the index in other planar polygons, so the equality is not automatic in dimension two. Explicit independent witnesses for each nonincident coordinate sharpen the structural statement. Value is not assigned to recomputing the established ordinary index.
residual_risks: No claim to classify all optimizers or resolve rank-one attainment on other polygons.
